reviews.title: Good app, but…
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for so long it seems to me that it was called something else before it was Yolmo. Now, all of a sudden, I go to get back into the Python 3 module and it’s locked pending membership purchase?!? There are other (likely better) free apps out there, but I’d be willing to pay for this one. Once. Not monthly or annually! There’s nothing here worth paying a monthly subscription for! Maybe $4.99 one time purchase, but that’s it. Sorry, but unless the pricing model changes I’ve gotta move on to something else.

reviews.title: App is not opening
reviews.text:
The app opened and ran fine the first time I downloaded it on my iPhone and iPad; however, after using “Sign Up/In with  Apple,” I was met with a never ending loading screen and wasn’t unable to proceed further——uninstalling and reinstalling didn’t work. In fact, after reinstalling, I’m not even able to access the Sign In page because it’s just loading and loading. 

I downloaded the iPad version of the app on my M1 mac and it worked fine when I didn’t use the Sign-in with Apple function. 

I am on the latest iOS/iPadOS betas on the respective devices (iPhone 13 pro, M1 iPad Pro), I dunno if that’s possibly causing the issue.

reviews.title: Big Problem
reviews.text:
Getting back into programming and by review seems to be the best app. Love that the devs stay on top of ratings and reviews. Unfortunately the app is broken on my iPad(2021). Playground tab is completely empty, workspaces tab is empty(upon hitting plus button nothing happens), and attempting to open profile crashes the app. Reinstalled twice with no resolution. Please get back to me, would love to give the app a chance.

Edit: Fixed the problem by opening the app from the AppStore rather than pressing it on my Home Screen. I believe the issue has something to do with the app not displaying the log in screen upon opening it for the first time. 

Unfortunately a new issue I discovered on the iPad(2021) with this app. Changing orientation of the device will sometimes cut half of the screen off prompting me to have to restart the app in my desired orientation.
